description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe holding a black poodle while sitting on the steps of the doorway in the adobe walled courtyard of her Abiquiu house; she is wearing a long black coat, a black hood, black leather gloves, the poodle is standing on its hind legs with its paws leaning on O'Keeffe's lap; triangular dark shadows across lower edge of photograph and upper corner of doorway.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
